### 1. Request, simulator role, authorisation
Dominic Boudreaux wants "the money you paid for the federal flood policy back for the time since the HomeFlood plan started" (HomeFlood renters plan covering his belongings since June 20). He will "do your part on this call", says "go ahead" when told something must be done first, and signs a request "using exactly the reason, the document and the date the representative tells you to use". Only if asked: he has the HomeFlood declarations page; nobody else pays the federal premium; in July he raised contents coverage and paid by card. Passive simulator; the user tool is the signing tool.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at 2026-10-13
Act now (cancel and refund). Policy 1152297408 (`e019b738…`) NFIP Dwelling Form – Tenant Contents, `in_force` (cancellation needs "pending effective or in force"); not mortgage-required, so no lender release is needed; a cancellation is processed only on the named insured's signed request ("a verbal statement does not take its place"); reason Replaced by Private Flood with the private policy's declarations ("Replaced by Private Flood | The private policy's declarations"); no claims on file, so the claim bar and hold do not engage.

### 3. Objects and correlation keys
NFIP policy term 2026-07-15 → 2027-07-15 (365 days); original effective 2021-07-15; contents 45000, deductible 1500; `map_revision_date` 2025-09-15, zone AE; rated RP 431.00 (after EC); payor INSURED. Pending COVERAGE_INCREASE `3b8e51c2…` recorded 2026-07-16 (contents 55000, no loan closing date, engine RP 531.00, no effective date). EC `c20b0a65…` applied, effective 2026-09-26. Billing current term: RP 486.00, RFA 87.48, HFIAA 25.00, FPF 47.00; payments 645.48 ACH 07-08 and 52.23 CREDIT_CARD 07-20; RERATE credits RP 44.00 and RFA 7.92 (09-26); refund 51.92 (09-29). Earlier terms excluded (fully earned). HomeFlood (other product): HF1260814 HomeFlood Renters, `active`, `replaced_nfip_policy_number` 1152297408, application 2026-06-12, effective 2026-06-20, basis NFIP_REPLACEMENT, plan ANNUAL, deductible 2000, one payment 2026-06-12. No claims on either policy.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Insured-requested coverage increase `3b8e51c2` (bill_insured_increase): receipt = later of 07-16 and latest payment on/after it (card 07-20) = 2026-07-20. Waiting-days tier "recorded map revision placed the building in an SFHA and receipt no later than 13 calendar months after" (2025-09-15 + 13 months = 2026-10-15 ≥ 07-20) → 1 day → 2026-07-21 (no coming-term payment, so the renewal line is not reached). Premium window 30 days (card, 4 days) inside; quote window 30 days (request carries an engine figure; 4 days) inside → effective 2026-07-21, 359 days to term end. Rise tier "re-rate credit from an applied EC booked on the current term after the request was recorded" (09-26 > 07-16) → 531.00 − 486.00 = 45.00. Charge 45 × 359/365 = 44.26; RFA 7.97; endorsed RP 431.00 + 45.00 = 476.00.
(b) Signed request (sign_cancellation_request, user): reason REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD, document PRIVATE_FLOOD_DECLARATIONS. Date: standard = signing date 2026-10-13; anchor tier "replacing HomeFlood effective on/after this policy's original effective date and no later than the signing date" → 2026-06-20; backdating window 120 days (no loss in last 12 months; 115 days) inside; breadth test: own deductible = contents 1500 (no building coverage), replacing 2000, not mortgage-required + Renters → allowed excess 1000 (excess 500) passes; lead window 30 days (NFIP replacement basis; 8 days) inside; paid-up window 365 days (annual; 123 days) inside → requested_effective_date 2026-06-20 (latest of the dates the rules give).
(c) Processing (process_policy_cancellation): cancellation date 06-20 is on or before the current term start 07-15. Refund-method tier "cancellation that takes effect on or before the current term start" → term-start RP 486.00 and RFA 87.48 in full; endorsement fraction tier "increase took effect after the cancellation date" → 1 (44.26, 7.97 back); re-rate fraction tier "rating change after the cancellation date" → 1 (44.00, 7.92 taken back). Risk credit 486.00 + 44.26 − 44.00 = 486.26; RFA credit 87.48 + 7.97 − 7.92 = 87.53; other-lines tier "effective on or before the current term start" → HFIAA 25.00 in full, ICC 0.00, fees earned; claim bar clear (no claim reported). Refund 598.79 to INSURED.

Fall-back (computation documents alone): increase dated 30 days after receipt (2026-08-19), rise 100.00 → 90.41 / 16.27; request dated the signing day 2026-10-13; Pro Rata at term share 275/365 → risk (486.00 + 90.41 − 44.00) × 275/365 = 401.13, etc. Definite and different from 598.79.
Factor findability: HomeFlood record words (`replaced_nfip_policy_number`, `effective_date`, `waiting_period_basis` NFIP_REPLACEMENT, `payment_plan`, deductible, its ledger) → the replacement anchor/backdating/breadth/lead/paid-up documents (each names Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies); `map_revision_date`, payment `posted_date`/`payment_method`, RERATE rows → the insured-increase waiting/window/rise documents; cancellation date vs `term_start` → refund-method and other-lines documents; EC `change_effective_date` → re-rate fraction document.

### 5. Executable sequence
verify (phone + ZIP) → reads → KB → unlock + call `bill_insured_increase_9da169e7` (policy `e019b738…`, change `3b8e51c2…`, 2026-07-21, 44.26, 7.97, 476.00) → unlock_user_discoverable_tool `sign_cancellation_request_cbba569e`, hand over (REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD, PRIVATE_FLOOD_DECLARATIONS, 2026-06-20) → read the request reference from the shared receipt or `find_dwelling_requests` → unlock + call `process_policy_cancellation_6794673f` (486.26, 87.53, 25.00, 0.00, 598.79, INSURED). The billing and the signing are not ordered against each other; both precede processing.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
Root: cancellation refund (processing). Edges:
1. Processing ← signed request stating the date. Hub sentence: "The cancellation credit is fixed only after the policy carries the named insured's signed cancellation request stating the date the cancellation takes effect." Records: `find_dwelling_requests` → none. The signing document says signing puts "One signed cancellation request … on file for the policy". **state-derived**.
2. Processing ← insured's coverage increase billed. Hub sentence: "The cancellation credit is fixed only after the premium account carries the charge for every coverage increase the insured requested on the current term, because the cancellation returns the term's charges line by line." Records: COVERAGE_INCREASE recorded 07-16 (in the current term), no loan closing date, no effective date, no endorsement charge. Searching "coverage increase the insured requested" finds "Coverage Increases Requested by the Insured — Billing Rule", which posts "Endorsement charges … on the risk premium line and the reserve fund assessment line". **state-derived**.
No hop pre-solved; no document names another problem's tool.
Counter-proof "do only the refund": processing without the request is barred outright ("processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request"); processing with the request but the July increase unbilled returns the term "line by line" without that charge, which the hub sentence forbids. Closest alternatives excluded: dating the request the signing day (anchor tier and all windows pass); Pro Rata at term share (date on/before the term start); refunding prior-term days 06-20 → 07-15 ("A term that has already ended is fully earned"); refunding the fee (fees earned outside Duplicate/Closing Did Not Occur); rise 100 against rated 431 (EC credit after the request).

Policy-side notes (blind): the waiting-days tier reads "the policy's recorded map revision placed the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area"; the record shows only `map_revision_date` and zone AE — the reader infers the placement from the recorded date and the SFHA zone. Not a defect; noted for the comparison.
